data.content_ref: inline:Replace the single-pass skeptical fixpoint with a two-phase 'commit-then-explain' semantics: after the least fixpoint stabilizes, run a polynomial-time traversal that requires every accepted node to have at least one minimal defeat tree whose leaves are committed roots, and every refuted node to have a defeat tree explaining the defeat. Nodes failing the explanation check are demoted to suspended. This preserves determinism and polynomial cost because the traversal is on the already-computed labels, and it makes reinstatement a constructive by-product rather than an implicit label.
